title: Modal Dialog
description: Build a modal dialog component with open/close functionality, rendering, and confirm/cancel callbacks.

steps.title: Modal data structure
steps.description: Create a modal object with `id`, `title`, `content`, and `visible` (boolean) properties.
hints: id should be a unique string like 'modal-1'
content holds the main body text or HTML
visible controls whether the modal is shown

verification.failureMessage: Include id, title, content, and visible keys.

steps.title: openModal function
steps.description: Write `openModal(modalId)` that sets `visible` to `true` for the matching modal and logs `'Opened: [title]'`.
hints: Find the modal by id in a modals array
Set its visible property to true

verification.failureMessage: Set visible to true for the matching modal.

steps.title: closeModal function
steps.description: Write `closeModal(modalId)` that sets `visible` to `false` and logs `'Closed: [title]'`.
hints: Log the title of the closed modal

verification.failureMessage: Set visible to false for the matching modal.

steps.title: renderModal function
steps.description: Write `renderModal(modal)` that returns an HTML string for the modal overlay with title, content, and close button. Only renders if `visible` is `true`.
hints: Return empty string if not visible
Include a div for the overlay and one for the modal content

verification.failureMessage: Return HTML with title and content when visible is true.

steps.title: Confirm/cancel callbacks
steps.description: Add `onConfirm` and `onCancel` callbacks to the modal. Write `confirmModal(modalId)` and `cancelModal(modalId)` that invoke the callbacks and close the modal.
hints: Add onConfirm and onCancel function properties to modal
confirmModal should call onConfirm then closeModal
cancelModal should call onCancel then closeModal

verification.failureMessage: Invoke onConfirm callback and close the modal.
